pages.text: $(l)Charm paths$()$(br)Charms follow six paths of three tiers: tier one, the $(l)pacts$() and the $(l)laws$(). Each tier uses the one before as its main material.$(br2)$(li)Tier one on a basic altar$(li)Pacts on a transmutation altar$(li)Laws on a truth altar, with affix materials$(br2)The tiers give +10, +30 and +50 luck.
$(l)Crafting$()$(br)Crafting table: 8 alchemical source string around a book.$(br2)+5 attack, +5 armor, +5 luck.$(br2)The main material of the first tier of four paths.
